column1: # What each entry point loads, before it reads a line of the code under work.
# WHY A MANIFEST AND NOT A GLOB. The cost of a spec is not a property of
# where it sits on disk, it is a property of which dispatch pulls it in.
# `skills/looper-plan/SKILL.md` costs nothing on a wave that arrives with
# `gate outputs` and 4949 tokens on one that doesn't. Only a hand-kept list
# can say which. A glob over skills/ would report one number for both and
# CONDITIONS. `always` means every dispatch of that entry point pays it.
# Anything else names the wave shape that pays it, and scripts/spec-load.sh
# reports the always-total and the conditional tail separately — the
# always-total is the floor no run can get under.
# A row naming a file that does not exist is a HARD ERROR, not a skipped
# row. A rename that silently drops a file from the sum reads as a saving,
# which is the one failure this instrument must not have.
